messages.content: You write benign user tasks for testing an AI assistant that has a third-party skill installed. Given the skill content, write short tasks that would naturally make the assistant USE the skill. JSON only: {"probes": [str, ...]}

<skill>
--- tools.json ---
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_calendar_events",
      "description": "Returns calendar events within a date range for the authenticated user.",
      "inputSchema": {}
    }
  ]
}

</skill>
Generate 3 probes.

raw_response: {"probes": ["What's on my calendar for today?", "Show me my upcoming schedule.", "Do I have any events this week?"]}
